notes: Regexes are matched against the MaleCNS v1.0 `type` column; resolved 2026-09-14 against the bulk annotations file. `_unclear` photoreceptor variants are deliberately excluded. Unmatched patterns fail the build. 2026-09-14 expansion after the first build pruned the CX and HS/VS as unreachable: added the anterior visual pathway (MeTu->TuBu->ER ring neurons) that feeds the compass, and the DNs that HS/VS (DNp20/15/17), looming (DNp03/35/103) and PFL3 (DNa03/DNb01) actually target, all identified from the release's own connectivity. Input layer = photoreceptors + lamina: in v1.0 R1-R6 are annotated in only ~300-520 of ~880 columns per eye and almost none near the medulla centre, so the central patch contains few of them; the lamina monopolar cells (their direct targets) carry the input, as in flyvis.
